environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU

execution_contract.failure_policy: stop scheduling; preserve state; source change requires human review
execution_contract.hardware_policy: one GPU worker; no power/clock changes; disk/CUDA/WHEA/instability stops; no hardware retry
execution_contract.resume_policy: new immutable attempt; exact origin; only classified ordinary interruption auto-resumes; all failures stop

storage.checks: before/after cells and validation/compaction; every 60 seconds during work
storage.compaction: only validated-completed PatchCore embedding chunks; retain full inventory and durable deletion receipt
